name: mycrew-board
description: Layer 4/5 — the board: what is being done right now about what the plane says the product must be. Built on backlog.md, so tasks are plain markdown in the repo and the same board opens in a terminal or a browser. Every task carries where it came from — asked for by the human, or thought up by an agent and waiting to be approved — the feature it serves, and criteria somebody other than its executor can check. /board-init stands it up over the features the plane already holds; board-rules governs what a task carries and who may move it.
